name: app-transactions-table-dashboard-on-tilted-tablet-small
title: Fintech transactions table on a tilted tablet held before pastel glass coins, small crop
whatItIs: A cropped view of a tablet held in a dark hand showing a light transactions dashboard with three gradient summary cards, a filterable table with coloured status pills, against a pale blue sky and translucent lime and clear discs.
whatItMeans: Clear and modern; glass coins in the sky turn a dense table into something light.
techniques: Tilt a dense dashboard in perspective.
Use gradient summary cards on top.

vocabulary.definition: A card with a blurred colour fill and one metric.
A translucent 3D coin used as decoration.
A row of dropdown filters above a table.
